name: Dedicated Melee Slot
description: Carry a melee weapon in your secondary slot beside your pistol, and another in your primary slot. Pick each from the two halves of a small box on the player card (machete, stun-lance, saber, stun-baton, hatchet or shovel), or by name in melee-slot-weapon.txt (secondary) and melee-slot-primary.txt (primary). Works out of the box with no setup: double tap the game's primary slot key (1) to swap the primary to its melee, double tap the secondary slot key (2) for the secondary; a single tap is always the firearm. The slot keys follow your own rebinds. Two optional keys on the game's bindings page (MODS > DEDICATED MELEE SLOT: Melee 1, Melee 2; needs Mod Bindings Menu) do the same with any trigger you prefer. Survives death and respawn. Does nothing until a melee is set. The pick box needs Bingus Shared Loader v15+ (loaded last).
